Read all 45 Claude sessions back to Aug 30 and the Oct 19 runs of the Marketplace Monitor and Books refresh. Both routines stop on purpose and say why.

Daily run 10: D1 unreadable (day 8). Runner credit still out: runs 40 to 45 all green and all dead (34 h). Lightscout backfill found 12 emails, 59 pending. Weekly Insights ran Oct 30 without Stripe or D1, three questions open. Three quotes expire Nov 8 to 10. Get Lit draft 9 days old. No client mail. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 11: D1 unreadable (day 9). Runner credit still out (54 h): run 50 burned Pest Control Tullahoma, run 48 was a 2-second GitHub failure, run 49 claimed nothing. Lightscout backfill 36 checked, 0 emails, pool exhausted. No client mail in 2 days. PR #22 unchanged 3 days. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed. Self evaluation tonight.
Caught up the 11-01 dashboard write that the daily run lost to a worker restart (snapshots/latest version 21, history/2026-11-01).

Weekly self evaluation 2: read both repos, 49 sessions, every routine record, 29 runner runs and the week of dashboard history. Wrote docs/reviews/2026-11-01-weekly.md. Verdict: prospecting dead 132 of 168 h on API credit while green; Connor cleared two drafts and no decisions; the partner dropped a dashboard write, bloated the attention list and drifted from its prompt. Dashboard refreshed, review emailed.

Daily run 12: D1 unreadable (day 10). Runner runs 53 and 54 claimed nothing; credit last confirmed dead Nov 1 07:47 UTC. Lightscout 1 lead (HOA manager), 60 pending. Social batch missed a second Sunday. No client mail in 2 days. PR #22 unchanged 4 days. No cloud batch. Dashboard written, then brief emailed.
